001-empty-alerts.json.note: No agent waits on the user, so the alerts array is empty.

002-one-alert-permission.json.note: One alert with reason permission and every optional id set.

003-one-alert-question.json.note: One alert with reason question and every optional id set.

004-one-of-each-reason.json.note: Two alerts for two agents, one permission and one question.

005-tool-claude.json.note: One alert from the claude tool.

006-tool-codex.json.note: One alert from the codex tool.

007-tool-opencode.json.note: One alert from the opencode tool.

008-tool-antigravity.json.note: One alert from the antigravity tool.

009-tool-gemini.json.note: One alert from the gemini tool.

010-tool-cursor.json.note: One alert from the cursor tool.

011-tool-aider.json.note: One alert from the aider tool.

012-tool-other.json.note: One alert from the other tool.

013-host-cli.json.note: One alert from the cli host.

014-host-desktop.json.note: One alert from the desktop host.

015-host-vscode.json.note: One alert from the vscode host.

016-host-sdk.json.note: One alert from the sdk host.

017-host-ide.json.note: One alert from the ide host.

018-host-other.json.note: One alert from the other host.

019-account-id-null.json.note: account_id is null when the source gave no account.

020-session-id-null.json.note: session_id is null when the source gave no session.

021-request-id-null.json.note: request_id is null, so the agent itself is the key.

022-all-optional-ids-null.json.note: account_id, session_id and request_id are all null on a question alert.

023-max-alerts-64.json.note: 64 alerts for distinct agents, the maximum array length.

024-shared-root-id.json.note: Two agents under one root_id, since root_id is not a uniqueness key.

025-shared-session-id.json.note: Two agents sharing a session_id, which is allowed because only agent must be unique.

026-shared-request-id.json.note: Two agents sharing a request_id, which is allowed because only agent must be unique.

027-shared-account-id.json.note: Two agents sharing an account_id under different roots, which is allowed because only agent must be unique.

028-identical-except-agent.json.note: Two alerts identical in every field except agent, which is the only key.

029-since-equals-last-confirmed.json.note: since equal to last_confirmed_at is allowed.

030-since-earlier-than-confirmed.json.note: since is an hour before last_confirmed_at, the usual case after a fresh confirmation.

031-timestamps-at-ms-min.json.note: saved_at, since and last_confirmed_at all exactly at the legal minimum.

032-timestamps-at-ms-max.json.note: saved_at, since and last_confirmed_at all exactly at the legal maximum.

033-since-at-ms-min.json.note: since alone at the legal minimum.

034-last-confirmed-at-ms-max.json.note: last_confirmed_at alone at the legal maximum.

035-saved-at-ms-max.json.note: saved_at alone at the legal maximum.

036-other-tool-and-host.json.note: One alert using the other tool and the other host together.

001-root-array.json.note: The root must be an object, not an array.

002-root-null.json.note: The root must be an object, not null.

003-root-string.json.note: The root must be an object, not a string.

007-missing-alerts.json.note: alerts is required, even when it is empty.

008-unknown-top-level-field.json.note: An unknown top-level field is rejected.

009-schema-version-2.json.note: schema_version must be 1, so version 2 is rejected.

010-schema-version-string.json.note: schema_version must be the number 1, not the string 1.

011-privacy-contains-text-true.json.note: privacy.containsText must be false because the file holds no text.

014-saved-at-seconds.json.note: saved_at in seconds is below the millisecond range.

015-saved-at-string.json.note: saved_at must be an integer, not an ISO date string.

016-saved-at-below-min.json.note: saved_at one millisecond below 2000-01-01 UTC is rejected.

017-saved-at-above-max.json.note: saved_at one millisecond above 2100-01-01 UTC is rejected.

019-too-many-alerts.json.note: At most 64 alerts, so 65 is rejected.

020-alert-null-entry.json.note: Each alert must be an object, not null.

021-alert-missing-agent.json.note: agent is required on every alert.

022-alert-missing-tool.json.note: tool is required on every alert.

023-alert-missing-host.json.note: host is required on every alert.

024-alert-missing-root-id.json.note: root_id is required on every alert.

025-alert-missing-account-id.json.note: account_id is required on every alert.

026-alert-missing-session-id.json.note: session_id is required on every alert.

027-alert-missing-request-id.json.note: request_id is required on every alert.

028-alert-missing-reason.json.note: reason is required on every alert.

029-alert-missing-since.json.note: since is required on every alert.

030-alert-missing-last-confirmed-at.json.note: last_confirmed_at is required on every alert.

031-alert-leaked-prompt.json.note: A prompt field is rejected as unknown on an alert.

032-alert-leaked-cwd.json.note: A cwd field is rejected as unknown on an alert.

033-alert-leaked-title.json.note: A title field is rejected as unknown on an alert.

034-tool-gemini-cli.json.note: tool must be one of the listed values, and gemini-cli is not one.

035-host-terminal.json.note: host must be one of the listed values, and terminal is not one.

036-reason-waiting.json.note: reason is permission or question, and waiting is not a reason.

037-agent-raw-uuid.json.note: A raw UUID is not a salted 32-character hex id.

038-agent-uppercase.json.note: Ids are lowercase hex, so an uppercase agent is rejected.

039-root-id-raw-uuid.json.note: A raw UUID is not a salted 32-character hex id.

040-root-id-uppercase.json.note: Ids are lowercase hex, so an uppercase root_id is rejected.

042-account-id-raw-uuid.json.note: A raw UUID is not a salted 32-character hex id.

043-account-id-uppercase.json.note: Ids are lowercase hex, so an uppercase account_id is rejected.

044-session-id-raw-uuid.json.note: A raw UUID is not a salted 32-character hex id.

045-session-id-uppercase.json.note: Ids are lowercase hex, so an uppercase session_id is rejected.

046-request-id-raw-uuid.json.note: A raw UUID is not a salted 32-character hex id.

047-request-id-uppercase.json.note: Ids are lowercase hex, so an uppercase request_id is rejected.

048-request-id-too-short.json.note: An id must be exactly 32 hex characters, and this one has 31.

049-since-seconds.json.note: since in seconds is below the millisecond range.

050-last-confirmed-seconds.json.note: last_confirmed_at in seconds is below the millisecond range.

051-since-string.json.note: since must be an integer, not an ISO date string.

052-since-below-min.json.note: since one millisecond below 2000-01-01 UTC is rejected.

053-since-above-max.json.note: since one millisecond above 2100-01-01 UTC is rejected.

054-last-confirmed-below-min.json.note: last_confirmed_at one millisecond below 2000-01-01 UTC is rejected.

055-last-confirmed-above-max.json.note: last_confirmed_at one millisecond above 2100-01-01 UTC is rejected.

056-duplicate-agent.json.note: Two alerts for the same agent break the agent uniqueness rule.

057-duplicate-agent-other-tool.json.note: The same agent under a different tool and host is still a duplicate.
